message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage, and let me tell you, I finally felt like the prepared one for once! I dug out my trusty flashlight and a couple of power banks to keep our phones charged. It was a cozy evening sitting with my husband, playing cards by lantern light instead of scrolling on our devices. Who knew being ready could feel so rewarding? Have you ever felt like a hero during an unexpected moment like that?
